name: typewriter-effect
title: Typewriter Effect
description: A small grey eyebrow line above a large bold headline that fills in one character at a time when it enters view. A thin blue cursor bar blinks after the text and the last word is blue.
use: A short headline or slogan that should feel typed in as the page loads.
avoid: Long or essential copy: characters begin hidden, and the caret blinks without pause.
a11y: Each letter is its own span, so screen readers may spell the headline out, and reduced-motion is not handled. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black stage with a small grey sentence above a large bold white headline. The headline types out left to right with a thin blue vertical caret after it, and the final word is blue and wraps onto a second line.
behaves: When it scrolls into view the characters pop in one after another with a stagger, revealing each word. The blue caret blinks continuously and the last word stays blue once printed.
customise: Pass a words array of text plus optional per-word className; the caret colour and size come from cursorClassName and styles, while timing is fixed.
weight: light: Words are split into character spans with one stagger; the caret loop is trivial.
